description: Calendar branch of the peak experiment tree: retrain sampled MLPs with annual_calendar=0, starting from the original square-root/local-noise recipe and its peak-log-loss-weight-0.3 child. Each held-out fold trains on the other three seasons among 2022-23 through 2025-26. Training histories are finalized admissions and flu-ED; labels are 36 finalized future weeks of both series. Both retain weekly, path and peak losses; the log0.3 child adds peak-week log loss. Two seeds (44,45). Evaluate held-out 2024-25 and 2025-26 on strict archived Wednesday reports with final NHSN peak labels and matched FluSight-ensemble tasks. Retrospective development comparison, not untouched validation.
